strings: m_c has always struggled to make out the words others say. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} may have auditory processing disorder.
m_c often struggles to make out what {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} clanmates are saying, as it all sounds like a jumble to {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
r_c0 tells m_c that, while {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} auditory processing disorder is permanent, it won't be a problem for {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} clanmates to accomadate {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
